subject.title: fix(agents): write unresumable notice to transcript for non-deliverable channels

question: Should WebChat's unresumable restart-recovery notice be persisted as a delivery-mirror assistant row in the session transcript, or should this wait for a broader restart-recovery/storage design?
rationale: The patch is a narrow source-backed fix, but it changes the durable transcript contract for failed non-deliverable recovery sessions and overlaps with broader recovery-route and recover-and-continue design work.

options.title: Accept Guarded Transcript Notice
options.body: Land this approach after conflict resolution if maintainers agree that WebChat should see the failure notice through persistent chat.history rows.

options.title: Require Live WebChat Proof First
options.body: Ask for a short restart/reconnect proof before accepting the contract, while keeping the implementation direction open.

options.title: Defer To Broader Recovery Design
options.body: Pause or close this branch if restart deferral, SQLite route persistence, or recover-and-continue should define the durable behavior first.

recommendation.title: Accept Guarded Transcript Notice
recommendation.body: Land this approach after conflict resolution if maintainers agree that WebChat should see the failure notice through persistent chat.history rows.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest available owner signal for the adjacent restart-recovery storage contract and delivery-mirror transcript behavior.
